notes: System name = LanHAR. Title changed across arXiv versions: v1-v3 'Language-centered Human Activity Recognition' -> v4 (Oct 20 2025) 'Large Language Model-Guided Semantic Alignment for Human Activity Recognition'. Cross-dataset IMU HAR: uses an LLM to generate semantic interpretations (text) of both raw sensor readings and activity labels, with an iterative re-generation step for interpretation quality and a two-stage training framework aligning sensor-reading text embeddings with activity-label text embeddings; distills a lightweight sensor encoder for mobile deployment. Text encoder is a pretrained language model (BERT-family; SciBERT-style label embeddings per seed). Evaluated on five public HAR datasets; reports +7.35% accuracy and +13.16% F1 over SOTA in cross-dataset HAR and supports new/unseen activities. DROPPED baseline (kept in related work only, per HALO plan: slow to run). Code: github.com/DASHLab/LanHAR.
